args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your website and it's a great start. I'd love to see more content and personal details added to it!
Hi Eve! I really enjoyed your blog. Your passion for hiking comes through clearly! Keep up the great work.

final_text:
I have visited both websites and sent the feedback:

1.  **Dora**: I invited her to Slack using her email (dora@gmail.com) and sent her a message suggesting she add more content and personal details to her website.
2.  **Eve**: I sent her a message praising her blog and her passion for hiking.
